report.summary: The only failure is test_invalid_book_is_rejected[blank-title]: a whitespace-only title is accepted with 201 instead of rejected with 422. The app code shows this is the seeded blank_title bug, which is active only when the BUGS env var contains blank_title; the repo's workflow does not set BUGS, so first confirm where that variable came from in this run's environment, then fix or disable the seeded bug in app/main.py:86.

causes.title: Whitespace-only book titles are accepted because the blank_title seeded bug is enabled
causes.explanation: validate_book only rejects a blank title when "blank_title" is not in BUGS. With BUGS containing blank_title, the check is skipped, so {"title": "   ", "author": "A"} is stored and returns 201. The test's expectation (422 with 'Title must not be blank') matches the intended spec, so the test is right to fail. The other three parametrized cases passed, which fits BUGS being exactly blank_title: year_off_by_one is not active (next-year still gets 422), and the empty-author and year-zero checks are unaffected. The repo's workflow (.github/workflows/tests.yml) does not set BUGS, so the variable must come from the CI runner or the environment the app inherits; this is the only way the defect could be on.
evidence: tests/api/test_books_api.py:66: assert response.status_code == 422 -> AssertionError: assert 201 == 422 (response 201 Created)
app/main.py:86: if not book.title.strip() and "blank_title" not in BUGS:  (the blank-title check is skipped when blank_title is in BUGS)
app/main.py:31: BUGS = {b.strip() for b in os.environ.get("BUGS", "").split(",") if b.strip()}
app/main.py:10: blank_title      accepts a title made only of spaces
tests/conftest.py:57: env = {**os.environ, "DB_PATH": db_path}  (the app process inherits BUGS from the environment)
tests/api/test_books_api.py:56: ({"title": "   ", "author": "A"}, "Title must not be blank") expects 422 with this message
Workflow .github/workflows/tests.yml sets no BUGS variable (only pytest -m api and report flags)
causes.suggested_fix: Confirm whether BUGS=blank_title is set on the CI runner or in the job environment and remove it if it was not meant to be there. If the seeded bug is meant to be on, mark this test as an expected failure for that configuration, or move the seeded-bug checks into a separate suite. Do not change the test: its assertion matches the intended behavior. The app fix is to remove the "blank_title" not in BUGS exemption at app/main.py:86.
